General Information
NEW in the Original Packaging
Stocked & Shipped From – LEXINGTON, KY
What is This Part?
This is the Suzuki OEM Wheel Bearing replacement Kit and Knuckle Rebuild Kit that repairs leaking seals or bad bearings along with leaking front knuckles in the front axle.
It does BOTH sides.
Note: To keep cost down we don’t sell you parts that are typically good to reuse (ie. metal washer, bolts etc¦)
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 2 Axle Oil Seals 09283-26016
Qty 2 Hub Oil Seals 09283-50002
Qty 2 Hub Seal/Wipers 09285-00002
Qty 4 Front Wheel Bearings 09265M41001
Qty 4 Half Oil Seal Retainers 45623M80001
Qty 2 Felt Swivel Seals 45600-82810
Qty 4 Half-Cover, Oil Seal 45625M63001
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ413 1985 – 1995 All Models
